source.title: Referendum results: Treaty of Lisbon I (2008)
source.check: National result compared: Yes 752,451, No 862,415 (46.6% / 53.4%) against our outcome, yes %, no %. Agrees. Our file holds no vote counts (Yes and No are 0), so only the outcome and the percentages could be checked; the source counts could fill them. The data.gov.ie dataset for the 2008 28th Amendment carries the 2009 (Lisbon II) file, so ElectionsIreland was used.
